title: Forest Witch Apothecary
description: A purple-haired female elf with butterfly wings sits inside a hollow tree transformed into an enchanted apothecary. She holds a golden bowl while surrounded by shelves of glowing potions, hanging lanterns, magical scrolls, and bioluminescent mushrooms in a lush nocturnal forest.
prompt: A beautiful purple-haired elf witch with butterfly wings wearing white robes sits inside a massive ancient tree hollow turned into a magical apothecary shop. Shelves filled with glowing potions and bottles, open books, hanging red lanterns and scrolls, bioluminescent mushrooms growing on mossy branches, mystical forest at night with soft moonlight filtering through the canopy, intricate details, rich fantasy atmosphere
